exp.desc:
- Around 25 placements a year
- Direct sourcing, interviews, client advice

cl.p1: four years at an engineering recruitment agency have meant around 25 placements a year, mostly engineers and technicians for mid-sized manufacturers. What I missed was seeing how people were doing a year later. In-house, I can.
cl.p2: My strength is approaching specialists who are not looking to move. I understand enough engineering to talk about someone’s work without embarrassing myself. Your careers page lists thirty open roles in development and production, and I would like to help fill them.

cl.p1: six years of field sales have taught me how to call people who were not expecting my call. Last year I introduced two friends to open roles at my company, and I realised that matching people to jobs suits me better than selling drinks.
cl.p2: I have completed a short recruitment course and know the basics of equality law. Phone work, networking and persistence are my strengths; the specialist knowledge I will learn in your team.
